about: Machine-readable comparison data for tools used by AI agents: web search APIs, voice and transcription APIs, MCP servers and tool platforms, automation platforms, and data enrichment APIs. Compiled from vendor-published pricing and documentation pages. Prices and limits are as published on the last_verified date and change often; verify before purchase. Fields that a vendor does not publish (for example some rate limits) are omitted rather than estimated.
notes: Coverage note: the 'Web scraping & browser APIs' category has no tools in this release. That category's verification pass could not be completed for this build, and unverified tools were not listed rather than guessed. Firecrawl, Apify, and Browserbase are the planned first entries when verification is completed. Status changes caught during verification: Relay.app shut down permanently in 2026 and is listed as discontinued; Smithery ended its hosted connection services on 2026-10-31 and is now a free, non-proxied registry powered by Arcade.dev; standalone Clearbit pricing no longer exists post-HubSpot acquisition. ElevenLabs figures are from ElevenLabs' published pricing as carried by multiple secondary sources because elevenlabs.io blocked automated reading during verification. Make's entry price is now verified ($9/month billed annually, Core, 10,000 credits/month — Nov 2026 check); Clay's own pricing page shows two different Launch prices ($167 headline vs $185 in its FAQ) — both are recorded in Clay's entry.

price_note: 'entry_price' is the vendor's own published list price for the lowest paid tier, read on the vendor's pricing page and verified per-tool on each tool's 'last_verified' date. It is not a marketplace price; the vendor's current pricing page is the final word.
offer_url_note: Every tool carries 'offer_url' and 'offer_url_type'. At launch, offer_url is the tool's official site URL (affiliate programs pending); when a tracked affiliate link replaces it, offer_url_type will name the program. See https://agentstackdata.com/for-agents/ for dataset terms.
